study type: Observational, descriptive, longitudinal, prospective case series
cohort: 100 patients without uterine prolapse who underwent vaginal hysterectomy for benign uterine diseases at San Cristobal Central Hospital Dr. Jose Maria Vargas, Gynecology Department, between October 2011 and February 2013.
finding: The study found that vaginal hysterectomy in patients without uterine prolapse was associated with few intra and postoperative complications, short surgical time and low postoperative pain.
